==English== ===Alternative forms=== * {{l|en|soon as}} {{q|colloquial, ellipsis}} ===Pronunciation=== * {{audio|en|en-au-as soon as.ogg|a=AU}} * {{audio|en|en-us-as soon as.ogg|a=Midwestern US}} ===Conjunction=== {{en-head|conj}} # {{senseid|en|literal, conjunctive}} {{&lit|en|as|soon}} #: {{cot|en|no sooner than|no later than}} #: {{ux|en|I came '''as soon as''' I could.}} # {{senseid|en|at the moment when or immediately after}} At the [[moment]] when; [[immediately]] (after); [[instantly]]; directly. #: {{syn|en|no sooner than|immediately|once}} #: {{ux|en|'''As soon as''' he arrived, everyone gasped.}} #* {{RQ:Tennyson In Memoriam|XXVI|43|{{...}} that eye which watches guilt
⁠And goodness, and hath power to see
⁠Within the green the moulder’d tree,
And towers fall’n '''as soon as''' built— {{...}}}} # {{senseid|en|indicating preferences}} {{lb|en|idiomatic}} {{non-gloss|Used to indicate that the first action mentioned is as [[likely]] as, or is [[prefer]]red to, the second action mentioned}}. #: {{cot|en|no sooner than|before}} #: {{ux|en|I'd jump out the window '''as soon as''' not.}} #* '''2003''' Oct. 12, {{w|William Safire}} (quoting 1913 New York City court records), "[http://www.nytimes.com/2003/10/12/magazine/the-way-we-live-now-10-12-03-on-language-aggie-awards.html The Way We Live Now]," ''New York Times'' (retrieved 19 Sep 2015): #* {{quote-journal|en|date=April 5 2013|author=David Hathaway|title=Your 2nd Amendment Cop Buddy Will Take Your Guns|titleurl=https://www.lewrockwell.com/2013/04/david-hathaway/your-2nd-amendment-cop-buddy-will-take-your-guns/|journal=LewRockwell.com|accessdate=19 Sep 2015 |passage="[T]hey are the worst of the worst and they will shoot you just '''as soon as''' say Hello."|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20251211154008/https://www.lewrockwell.com/2013/04/david-hathaway/your-2nd-amendment-cop-buddy-will-take-your-guns/|archivedate=11 December 2025}} ====Derived terms==== * {{l|en|as soon as look at someone}} * {{l|en|as soon as possible}} ([[ASAP]]) ====Translations==== {{trans-top|immediately after}} * Arabic: * Armenian: * Asturian: * Breton: * Bulgarian: * Catalan: * Chinese: * Czech: * Danish: * Dutch: * Esperanto: * Faroese: * Finnish: * French: * Galician: * Georgian: * German: * Gothic: * Greek: * Hungarian: * Icelandic: * Irish: * Italian: * Japanese: * Khmer: * Latin: * Latvian: * Luxembourgish: * Norwegian: * Pannonian Rusyn: * Persian: * Polish: * Portuguese: * Romanian: * Russian: {{t+|ru|как то́лько}} * Serbo-Croatian: * Slovak: * Spanish: * Swedish: * Turkish: * Ukrainian: * Vietnamese: * Walloon: {{trans-bottom}} ===Preposition=== {{en-head|prep}} #
